stories.title: Run Qwen 3.8 Flash Next (125B) on consumer hardware (RTX 4090) at 100T/s
stories.reason: Direct hit on inference-infra/quantization taste: new MoE-offload technique runs a 125B model on a single consumer GPU.
key_facts: Strata (open-source) runs Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, a 125B-parameter MoE model, on consumer GPUs with as little as 12GB VRAM
24,576 total experts, only 10 active per output token; hot experts on GPU, all experts in RAM, overflow on CPU/SSD
Speculative 'guess and check' decoding gives 1.6-1.8x speedup
On RTX 5070 (12GB): 53-94 tok/s generation, 1,620-2,650 tok/s prompt processing depending on quantization (Q2_0/IQ2_XS/IQ3_XXS/IQ3_S)
Coder variant hits 91% SWE-bench at a 32GB footprint

stories.title: Show HN: AI search for every photo and every frame of video on macOS
stories.reason: Fully local, running semantic search tool over photos/video using CLIP/SigLIP + Whisper + OCR on macOS — concrete working system, not just a claim.
key_facts: SCM: local macOS app for semantic search across photos and every video frame, no cloud upload
Uses ONNX Runtime with CLIP ViT-L/14@336 (default) or SigLIP variants for embeddings; ffmpeg shot-boundary detection for video keyframes
Tesseract OCR (35+ languages), Whisper (tiny.en/base.en) for speech transcription, optional local llama.cpp chat over extracted metadata

key_facts: magpie: local gateway speaking OpenAI Chat Completions, OpenAI Responses, and Anthropic Messages APIs, forwarding to whichever vendor serves the chosen model
Listens on 127.0.0.1:3425; edits 50+ coding agents' config files surgically, preserving comments/ordering
4,861 GitHub stars; desktop (Wails), TUI, web, and CLI front-ends
